records.name: Praia 19
records.identity: Almada municipality officially names Praia Naturista da Bela Vista | Praia 19, with LGBT-popular nude bathing southern section, unlike nearby north concession bathing facilities. The Portugal Naturist Federation says Praia da Bela Vista was legally designated Feb 21, 1995. Existing 38.58609,-9.20414 broadly southern beach. Old name refers to beach train stop 19; do not rely on this as a currently operating rail stop.

activity.evidence: Poster describes times and what they claim happens in wooded areas; uncorroborated.
First-time person says they are on site and cannot locate claimed bushes; presence, not sex encounter.

records.access: Natural dune/pine woodland and beach. Official beach support WC/shade/guard applies to concessioned NORTHERN area, cannot be promised at southern secluded part. Sensitive habitats, marked trails and no trespass through fenced dunes.
records.duplicates: Praia da Bela Vista/Praia 19 denote connected named beach zones, not two separate unrelated listings; no independent second same-spot duplicate reviewed.
corrections: Strong independent confirmation of gay/LGBT significance (Almada municipal page), so no need to label gay-popular status merely anecdotal.
Retain distinction anonymous 2026 physical claims versus independently verified public naturist designation.
Don't invent toilets or lifeguard services on remote south area.
